answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen pricing, making the mandated 18% spend reduction unattainable through renewal or negotiation. The archived switching record is the highest-value verification because it bears directly on whether lower cost and rapid onboarding can be replicated before expiry. A primary switch is only supportable if the archived record confirms comparable component scope, qualification speed, and delivery performance; the 14-day expiry and 94% line utilization make transition disruption the central residual risk.
